notes: Enhanced ACT Math uses four answer choices and contains 45 questions in 50 minutes, including 41 operational items and 4 embedded field-test items.
Preparing for Higher Math accounts for about 80% of operational Math content and is divided into Number & Quantity, Algebra, Functions, Geometry, and Statistics & Probability.
Modeling is cross-cutting and should be tagged on appropriate content items rather than authored as a stand-alone domain.

ACT V2.1 native banks may later be crosswalked to active Texas standards where the relationship is defensible, but no TEKS is fabricated simply to host ACT-only constructs such as vectors or matrices.

constructs: properties of integer and rational exponents
